cells.gaps: The Schéma stratégique intégré's period ended in 2024 and no row shows a successor sector policy adopted or in preparation. The Politique nationale de développement des TIC is named by the minister in July 2025 (DJI-001) with no adoption date, standing, period or text, so it cannot be staged; that fact also falls outside the twelve months and belongs to the other instrument. No text, delivery plan, report, mandated body or finance is held for the SSI.
cells.note: Schéma stratégique intégré (SSI) 2014-2024: the newest sector policy on record as adopted, in 2014 for ten years, so expired before the as-at with no successor sector policy in preparation. An expired policy places nothing; a national digital strategy is held, which is noted and does not place the country.
